verdict.rationale: The SDK example shows a published-date filter (`startPublishedDate: "2024-01-01"`), so date-range filtering exists. Exa describes itself as a "real-time knowledge index" that it builds and maintains itself, and scheduled searches surface new web events. Freshness evidence beyond that is thin: missing for 10: documented end-date and relative-recency options (e.g. last N days or live crawl), stated index update frequency or crawl cadence, and any independent or hands-on corroboration that results are fresh.
